routes.label: self-service portal: at most 30 days from acceptance
service office: at most 30 days from acceptance

note: Validity is 'up to' 10 years (adult) and 5 (child). Ordering a document to a foreign representation adds 20 euros. From retirement age the fees are EUR 20 (portal) and 25 (office); the game charges the adult fee until the retirement age is read. A child's expedited fee isn't given.

sources.title: Police and Border Guard Board (politsei.ee), Estonian passport for an adult
sources.said: The Estonian citizen's passport has a term of validity of up to 10 years.

sources.title: Police and Border Guard Board (politsei.ee), Estonian passport for an adult: Applying at the self-service portal
sources.said: State fees Passport The state fee for a passport is €50. The state fee for a passport is €20 for people who have reached the general retirement age applicable in Estonia ... The state fee for applying for a passport on an expedited basis is €250. Ordering a document to a foreign representation will cost €20 in addition to the state fee.

sources.title: Police and Border Guard Board (politsei.ee), Estonian passport for an adult: Applying for a passport at a service office
sources.said: After your application has been accepted, it will take a maximum of 30 days to prepare your passport under ordinary procedure ... It will take a maximum of 1 working days to prepare a passport applied for under expedited procedure ... The state fee for a passport is €60. The state fee for a passport for those who have reached retirement age in Estonia is €25 ... The state fee if you are applying for the passport under expedited procedure is €250.

sources.title: Police and Border Guard Board (politsei.ee), Estonian passport for a child
sources.said: The Estonian citizen's passport has a term of validity of up to 5 years.

sources.title: Police and Border Guard Board (politsei.ee), Estonian passport for a child: Applying at the self-service portal
sources.said: State fees Passport The state fee for a passport is €20.

sources.title: Police and Border Guard Board (politsei.ee), Estonian passport for a child: Applying for a passport at a service office
sources.said: State fees Estonian citizen's passport The state fee for a passport for a child under the age of 18 is €25. The state fee for a passport for those 18 and over is €60.
